verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's core product is self-serve funnel and retention analysis (drop-off/conversion reporting, no-code UI) explicitly designed for non-analysts, reinforced by community praise ('PMs spend hours in mixpanel quickly generating custom report after custom report') and Flow feature for visualizing user paths. Some UI usability complaints exist, but the core self-serve funnel capability is well-documented and validated by hands-on users.
